description: The product ONE SHOP'S PAGE sells, read now from its URL: name, brand, model, barcode, price, currency, stock, condition, size, color - from the page's own product data when it carries it, else read by a language model. USE WHEN the user gives a product URL on a shop's site (not Amazon / Walmart) and wants its price or details, or wants it matched to Amazon / Walmart (match=true). DON'T USE for Amazon or Walmart URLs (product), for finding other shops (web_offers) or for a whole page's text (web_page). RETURNS outcome (product | no_product), product, extraction (structured | model), tier (direct | residential | browser), final_url, read_at, listings[] with match=true. HONESTY: a page that none of the three routes delivers is not read (nothing billed); search engines, social networks and non-public addresses are never read. LATENCY 1-90 SECONDS. COST paid plans: the page (1 plain request, 4 residential route, 10 read in a browser) + 1 when the page carries its own product data or + 5 when the model reads it; + 10 for a matched listing; a page not read is free.

marketplaces.description: match=true: Amazon marketplaces and walmart, comma-separated.

match.description: Also find the same product on our Amazon / Walmart records.

max_age_hours.description: Answer from a read of the same URL within this many hours (same price). 0 = a fresh read.

url.description: The shop's product page URL (http or https).

name: web_product
